name: Make Rugs!
desc:
Welcome to Make Rugs!

🧶 Roll for rare yarn and discover new colors!  
🎨 Pick a design and bring it to life with your tufting tool!  
✂️ Shave your rugs smooth for a satisfying finish!  
💰 Sell your creations to customers in your shop!  
📱 Complete orders from your phone!  
👷 Hire employees to help your studio grow!
💤 Your employees work offline!

Turn your little workshop into a rug-making empire! ✨
